items.title: Wolfspeed launches Premium 200mm n-type SiC substrate, orderable now
items.text: Wolfspeed introduced a Premium 200mm n-type SiC substrate with fewer than 0.01 micropipes per square centimetre (under three per wafer), saying its 200mm operations have been in continuous production since 2022. It is aimed at higher-voltage, larger-die devices and better yields. For India's early SiC entrants such as RIR (epi) and L&T Semiconductor (fabless), it shows the quality bar set by incumbents.
